About this portfolio

This portfolio brings together planning, inventory, invoice and warehouse tools documented in the source showcase. Each project detail is based on the supplied descriptions and original screenshots.

The showcase includes offline and online dashboard modes, file upload and data-quality workflows, planning calculations, stock allocation and rebalancing, serial-number utilities, vendor stock processing and warehouse productivity views.

Use the project cards to inspect the individual tool details. Screenshots can be opened full-size by selecting an image.

How to read the project details

  • Descriptions and workflow notes are taken from the supplied tool showcase.
  • Original screenshots are embedded in this page; they have not been altered.
  • Where the source document does not show a screen or define a behaviour, this page does not invent one.
  • *The source showcase states that ten tools run in a browser; the 3PP CS Data Dashboard also has an online version.
